SELECT_USUARIO_BY_TOKEN: SELECT u.* FROM Usuario u INNER JOIN UsuarioToken ut ON u.id = ut.id_usuario WHERE REPLACE(UPPER(ut.token), '-', '') = REPLACE(UPPER(?), '-', '')
UPSERT_TOKEN: INSERT INTO UsuarioToken (id_usuario, token, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?) ON CONFLICT(id_usuario) DO UPDATE SET token = excluded.token, created_at = excluded.created_at
SELECT_CANAIS_USUARIO: SELECT c.* FROM Canal c INNER JOIN CanalUsuario cu ON c.id = cu.id_canal WHERE cu.id_usuario = ? AND c.status = 1 ORDER BY c.nome ASC
SELECT_CATEGORIAS: SELECT * FROM Categoria ORDER BY categoria ASC
SELECT_CURSOS_RECENTES: SELECT c.* FROM Curso c WHERE c.status = 1 AND (c.data_publicacao IS NULL OR c.data_publicacao <= ?) ORDER BY COALESCE(c.data_publicacao, c.created_at) DESC LIMIT ? OFFSET ?
SELECT_CURSOS_BY_CATEGORIA: SELECT c.* FROM Curso c INNER JOIN CursoCategoria cc ON c.id = cc.id_curso WHERE cc.id_categoria = ? AND c.status = 1 AND (c.data_publicacao IS NULL OR c.data_publicacao <= ?) ORDER BY COALESCE(c.data_publicacao, c.created_at) DESC LIMIT ? OFFSET ?
SELECT_EPISODIOS_BY_CURSO: SELECT e.*, COALESCE(ep.progresso, 0) AS progresso, COALESCE(ep.concluido, 0) AS concluido FROM Episodio e LEFT JOIN EpisodioProgresso ep ON e.id = ep.id_episodio AND ep.id_usuario = ? WHERE e.id_curso = ? AND e.status = 1 AND (e.data_publicacao IS NULL OR e.data_publicacao <= ?) ORDER BY COALESCE(e.data_publicacao, e.created_at) ASC
SELECT_CONTINUE_WATCHING: SELECT COALESCE(ep.progresso, 0) AS progresso, COALESCE(ep.concluido, 0) AS concluido, (SELECT MAX(ep2.updated_at) FROM EpisodioProgresso ep2 INNER JOIN Episodio e2 ON ep2.id_episodio = e2.id WHERE ep2.id_usuario = ? AND e2.id_curso = c.id) AS updated_at, e.id AS episodio_id, e.nome AS episodio_nome, e.thumbnail AS episodio_thumbnail, e.url AS episodio_url, e.media_type, e.id_curso, c.nome AS curso_nome, c.thumbnail AS curso_thumbnail FROM Curso c INNER JOIN Episodio e ON e.id_curso = c.id LEFT JOIN EpisodioProgresso ep ON ep.id_episodio = e.id AND ep.id_usuario = ? WHERE c.status = 1 AND e.status = 1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM EpisodioProgresso ep3 INNER JOIN Episodio e3 ON ep3.id_episodio = e3.id WHERE ep3.id_usuario = ? AND e3.id_curso = c.id) AND (ep.concluido IS NULL OR ep.concluido = 0) ORDER BY updated_at DESC, COALESCE(e.data_publicacao, e.created_at) ASC
UPSERT_PROGRESSO: INSERT INTO EpisodioProgresso (id_episodio, id_usuario, progresso, concluido, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?) ON CONFLICT(id_episodio, id_usuario) DO UPDATE SET progresso = excluded.progresso, concluido = excluded.concluido, updated_at = excluded.updated_at
SELECT_PROGRESSO: SELECT * FROM EpisodioProgresso WHERE id_episodio = ? AND id_usuario = ?
